priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/socket.ts registers handler with socket.on("message", handler) but the returned cleanup at line 3 is still an empty function; the full diff confirms this PR replaced socket.off("message", handler), so cleanup leaves the listener active.
